# `aitbc exchange order book`

Show the hub exchange's open order book (read-only). Unlike ``order my`` this needs no wallet or address — the book is a public read of open BUY/SELL orders on the exchange service.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc exchange order book [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--exchange-url` | text | — | no | Override exchange service base URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc exchange order book
```
